name: Rackzar
reputation: Proxmox partner with 400 Gbit peering, local support and dual-city presence in Johannesburg and Cape Town.
notes: Prices include VAT. Quick support response observed. Uses Cloudflare, so the scraper fetches through a reader proxy.

name: Absolute Hosting
reputation: Long-running South African host with budget AMD EPYC VPS plans, instant upgrades and a self-managed firewall.
notes: VAT treatment not stated on the store page; treated as exclusive for comparison. Support was poor in our experience and only WhatsApp was available.

name: Hostking
reputation: Established South African host. The VPS product is no longer advertised on the main site as of November 2026; the last known plan is retained for history.
notes: VPS removed from the current site; plan archived and excluded from live rankings. Last verified via number1.co.za (September 2026).

name: Cloud.co.za
reputation: Trading as cloud.co.za and vps.co.za; KVM-based Linux cloud servers on local infrastructure with optional backup plans.
notes: Recurring monthly prices are used; first-month promotions are ignored. Prices include VAT. Quick response from the chat bot in our experience.

name: CloudAfrica
reputation: Enterprise cloud hosted at Teraco Isando with strong CPU performance in independent benchmarks.
notes: Prices are explicitly quoted excluding VAT and converted to inclusive prices for comparison. Smallest current package is 16 GB; the older 4 GB plan is no longer listed.

name: Web Telecoms
reputation: Cape Town ISP and host running its own low-latency South African network with fixed, simple VPS packages.
notes: Terms state invoices are issued inclusive of VAT.

name: 1-grid
reputation: Large South African host offering self-managed or fully managed VPS. Support reputation is mixed.
notes: Pricing page prices include VAT. Quick response from the chat bot in our experience.

name: Domains.co.za
reputation: Teraco Isando infrastructure with AMD EPYC, DDR5 and NVMe, a 99.9% SLA and off-site backups.
notes: Pricing page states all prices include VAT.

name: HostAfrica
reputation: Pan-African host with South African data centres, API/CLI/MCP automation and unlimited traffic.
notes: First-month 50% promotions are ignored; recurring prices are used. Terms state fees are quoted inclusive of VAT unless indicated otherwise.

name: VirtualServers
reputation: AMD EPYC Genoa and NVMe with unmetered traffic. Cape Town capacity is available; Johannesburg is out of stock.
notes: Pricing page states VAT-inclusive pricing. 10% annual discount ignored; monthly price used.

name: iVeCloud
reputation: South African host with Johannesburg and Cape Town locations, DDoS protection and frequent 50% first-term promotions.
notes: List prices are used; the recurring 50% sale is ignored. VAT treatment not stated; treated as exclusive. Support took a long time to respond in our experience.

name: Toblo
reputation: South African host running AMD EPYC KVM VPS with NVMe storage, unlimited traffic and a 99.9% uptime SLA in Pretoria.
notes: Prices are advertised per month with no setup fee. VAT treatment is not stated on the pricing page, so prices are treated as exclusive for comparison.

name: Axxess
reputation: Established South African ISP offering self-managed VPS hosting with Samsung enterprise SSD storage, IPv4/IPv6 connectivity and free monthly backups.
notes: Prices include VAT. The four-month promotional price is ignored; the regular monthly price is used. The data-centre city is not stated on the pricing page. The product list is loaded from Axxess's JSON feed, which the scraper reads directly.
